responsibility: Tests `TaggedPtr`'s drop-aware tagged-pointer semantics, covering cloning and retagging for borrowed, boxed, and reference-counted pointers to confirm that ownership-sensitive pointer types preserve the correct pointee and tag behavior.
same_name_distinction: Within the tagged-pointer same-name group, this file is the runtime ownership-aware `TaggedPtr` suite, checking clone and retag behavior for borrowed pointers, `Box`, and `Arc`; unlike `copy/tests.rs`, it exercises non-`Copy` pointer ownership and pointee identity effects.
